Pricing
Real estate / Luxury brokerage

GEO for luxury real estate agencies in AI recommendations

A buyer of a premium home evaluates more than square metres and location. Discretion, relevant inventory, professional expertise and transaction support matter. I examine which estate agencies AI recommends for these needs and whether the available sources support the recommendation.

  • Non-brand questions by property type, area and service need
  • Evidence of actual broker specialisation and agency responsibilities
  • Privacy-safe treatment of off-market listings and transactions
Discuss your projectSee the industry method

Personally led by Alexey Yakovlev, GEO/AEO consultant

Selection barriers

An expensive listing catalogue is not proof of brokerage expertise

The same budget may cover a central-city apartment, a country residence or a sensitive off-market acquisition. Each buyer requires different evidence.

01

Private listings are presented as publicly available

A provider cannot claim access to an off-market property when authorisation, availability and disclosure terms have not been verified.

02

Premium positioning lacks usable criteria

Exclusive language alone does not establish neighbourhood expertise, property specialism or a discreet service process.

03

Transaction results are unsubstantiated

Invented deal volumes, named clients and unsupported completion claims must never be used as marketing evidence.

Buyer intents

Questions that lead to a luxury agency shortlist

Separate the agency-selection task from the selection of individual buildings. The baseline distinguishes buyers, sellers and transaction models.

Buyer questionEvidence neededGEO content task
Which agency handles boutique apartment buildings in central Moscow?Real service areas, broker expertise and current available offersSpecialist broker profiles and neighbourhood pages
Who assists with purchasing a countryside residence?Territory, due diligence scope, contract process and actual partnersA separate country-property service explanation
Who offers a discreet search for homes not publicly listed?Real private-search terms, confidentiality and permission to describe offeringsExplain the service without exposing inventory
How should I compare agencies selling a premium apartment?Fee terms, marketing scope, seller reporting and privacyTransparent brokerage process and fee FAQ
Verifiable facts

Evidence behind a luxury-broker recommendation

Registered property rights and transaction verification are separate from a brokerage pitch. Russian law regulates access to EGRN information; public content cannot replace a property-specific review or disclose confidential details.

  • Real broker identities and expertise, areas covered and public professional profiles
  • Commission, confidentiality, marketing scope, viewing process and legal-service boundaries
  • Permission-based cases and accurate statements about private listings

GAEO's residential-development research provides a measurement method, not a completed GEO success case for a luxury estate agency.

Scope of work

A GEO programme for a specialist luxury agency

The approach centres on responsible recommendations of qualified people and services, not mass reproduction of listings.

  1. 01

    Define buyer needs

    Separate central-city homes, country residences, private transactions and seller services by intent and geography.

  2. 02

    Verify what can be disclosed

    Review broker capabilities, contract conditions, confidentiality and permission to cite transactions.

  3. 03

    Build content evidence

    Specify agency service pages, biographies, sector materials and helpful transactional FAQ.

  4. 04

    Measure comparable recommendations

    Repeat stable prompts and examine BMR and factual errors across selected AI interfaces.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can a luxury agency use GEO without disclosing private transactions?+

Yes. Verified services, practitioner biographies and approved public evidence can support recommendations without confidential details.

How is agency GEO different from developer GEO?+

A developer is assessed for a property; an agency is selected for people, service and transaction terms.

Can off-market expertise be advertised?+

Only if the provider genuinely offers it. No unsupported inventory totals, exclusive rights or availability claims should be made.

What proves a property transaction is legally sound?+

Document and circumstance review for the specific property, performed by appropriately qualified professionals. Generic marketing statements are insufficient.

What is the GAEO price for a luxury agency?+

The current audit and monthly GEO plans apply. Final scope depends on target geography, services and usable evidence.
